isDisabled.name: Disabled
isDisabled.description: Whether the date field is disabled.

isReadOnly.name: Read Only
isReadOnly.description: Whether the date field is read only.

isRequired.name: Required
isRequired.description: Whether the date field is required.

isInvalid.name: Invalid
isInvalid.description: Whether the date field is in an invalid state.

hourCycle.name: Hour Cycle
hourCycle.description: Whether to display the time in 12 or 24 hour format.

granularity.name: Granularity
granularity.description: Determines the smallest unit that is displayed in the date field.

hideTimeZone.name: Hide Time Zone
hideTimeZone.description: Whether to hide the time zone abbreviation.

shouldForceLeadingZeros.name: Force Leading Zeros
shouldForceLeadingZeros.description: Whether to always show leading zeros in the month, day, and hour fields.
